subject: Re: Dedicated capacity pricing - Acme Analytics
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily@acme.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Mar 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity pricing - Acme Analytics

Hi Emily — great to meet you and the data platform team on the call today. Quick recap and next steps so we stay aligned: 

Call highlights:
- Acme expects to start with a 6-week pilot focused on inference for question-answering over internal docs and embeddings-based search.
- Initial scope: ~1M active monthly users, bursty traffic during business hours, avg request ~1200 tokens (prompt + response).
- Target latency: 200-400ms p90 for short prompts; can tolerate up to 800ms for longer generations.

Pricing/volume info we discussed — please confirm these so we can pin a dedicated config: 
- Estimated sustained token volume: 60M - 120M tokens / day (peak days up to ~200M) — roughly 1.8B - 3.6B tokens / month.
- Budget guidance: looking for target unit economics in the ballpark of $700 - $1,200 per 1M tokens for the pilot (open to adjustment for committed reserved capacity).
- Preferred GPU family: team mentioned H100 for best perf, but wants Redwood recommendation on cost/throughput tradeoffs.
- Throughput goal: support 250 concurrent streams with average per-stream token rate of ~12 tokens/sec; burst headroom to 400 concurrent streams.

Next steps: 
1) Emily to confirm the monthly token range and whether the procurement contact should be looped in (Procurement).
2) We (Redwood) to propose 2 configs: an A100-based reserved cluster and an H100-based reserved cluster with GPU counts, expected throughput, and estimated $/1M tokens.
3) Align on SLA and rollout timeline for the 6-week pilot.

I attached a short pricing draft for dedicated capacity (redwood-dedicated-pricing-v1.pdf) — baseline numbers, not final. Rishi, can you take point on sizing and draft the two config options? Emily — if Procurement should be looped for an NDA/PO, let me know and I’ll add them.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Emily Zhang <emily@acme.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Mar 2028 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity pricing - Acme Analytics

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and the quick turn. A few clarifications from our side: 

Confirmed volumes:
- For the pilot we expect ~2.2B tokens/month (avg). If pilot looks good, goal is to ramp to ~5B tokens/month within 3 months.
- Peak daily volume could reach 250M tokens on heavy days.

Budget:
- Procurement has given rough internal guidance for this initiative: target $/1M tokens of $800 for the pilot. There is room to increase with committed multi-month reserved capacity but Procurement will want a clear committed discount schedule.

GPU preference & latency:
- H100 is preferred because our ML team values lower latency and per-token cost at higher sequence lengths. If A100 is materially cheaper with similar latency for our workload, we are open to that as well — we rely on your SE to recommend.

Throughput:
- 250 concurrent streams sustained with 12 tokens/sec average is accurate. We need 400 concurrent burst headroom.

Procurement: procurement@acme.ai — please loop them for PO and contract redlines.

Thanks — Emily

Emily Zhang
Head of Data Products | Acme Analytics
emily@acme.ai | +1 (212) 555-0199

Date: Sat, 4 Mar 2028 09:30:00 -0700

Rishi — forwarding Emily's confirmation. Can you draft the two reserved configs (A100 vs H100) with:
- GPU count for the pilot (estimate both sustained and burst sizing)
- Expected throughput (concurrent streams, tokens/sec per GPU, p90 latency estimates)
- Monthly cost and derived $/1M tokens for both options, including reserved-capacity discounts and suggested committed term (3-month pilot vs 12-month commitment).

Please attach the pricing sheet and a short note on key tradeoffs. Goal: have a sendable proposal to Emily + Procurement by EOD Monday.

Thanks — Marissa

--
